onChange.template:
[Gameplan: update .gameplan/locomotion/category.schema.json, set lc_movement_style to {{lc_movement_style}}]
Set the movement style to {{lc_movement_style}} by adjusting MovementAbility: snappy=fast acceleration/low air control, balanced=defaults, floaty=slow acceleration/high air control.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/locomotion/category.schema.json, set lc_jump_style to {{lc_jump_style}}]
Set the jump style to {{lc_jump_style}} by adjusting JumpAbility.jumpImpulse: low_hop=low impulse, standard=default 5.0, high_leap=high impulse.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/locomotion/category.schema.json, set lc_dash_mode to {{lc_dash_mode}}]
Set the dash mode to {{lc_dash_mode}} by adjusting DashAbility: quick_burst=short distance short cooldown, standard=defaults, long_lunge=large distance long cooldown.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/locomotion/category.schema.json, set lc_strafe_mode to {{lc_strafe_mode}}]
Set MovementAbility.strafeMode: face_movement=character rotates to face movement direction, strafe=character always faces camera forward.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/locomotion/category.schema.json, set lt_move_speed to {{lt_move_speed}}]
Set MovementAbility.moveSpeed to {{lt_move_speed}} for the player character.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/locomotion/category.schema.json, set lt_acceleration_time to {{lt_acceleration_time}}]
Set MovementAbility.accelerationTime to {{lt_acceleration_time}}. Higher=sluggish start, lower=instant response.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/locomotion/category.schema.json, set lt_air_control to {{lt_air_control}}]
Set MovementAbility.airControlFactor to {{lt_air_control}}. Higher=less aerial control, lower=more responsive in air.

action.template: Add a new movement ability to the locomotion module.
Rebalance the locomotion feel for a more arcade-action style: snappier movement, higher jump, shorter dash cooldown.
